url.description: The base URL of the WebDAV server to test.

username.description: Username for authentication against the WebDAV server.

password.description: Password for authentication against the WebDAV server.

client_cert.description: Path to a PKCS#12 client certificate file for SSL client authentication. Leave empty if not using client certs.

proxy.description: URL of the proxy server to use for HTTP requests. Leave empty if no proxy.

keep_going.description: If true, continue testing even if one suite fails.

tests.description: List of test programs to run. Defaults to 'basic copymove props locks http'.

htdocs.description: Alternate document root for test files.
